product_overview: A modern, interactive portfolio website showcasing Charan Katkam's expertise as a Full Stack Developer with AI/ML specialization. The site highlights skills, projects, and contact details to attract recruiters, clients, and collaborators.
core_goals: Showcase Charan Katkam's technical skills and AI/ML expertise through categorized skills and detailed projects.
Provide an intuitive and engaging user interface demonstrating UI/UX design capabilities with smooth animations and responsive design.
Enable multiple easy contact methods including forms, social links, and resume download to facilitate communication.
Ensure accessibility, performance, and SEO best practices for a professional presence across devices and browsers.
key_features: Sticky header navigation with smooth scroll, active section highlighting, mobile hamburger menu, and dark/light theme toggle.
Animated hero section with text reveals, floating background elements, call-to-action buttons, and scroll indicator.
About section featuring an animated profile avatar, personal introduction, and quick facts.
Skills section categorizes frontend, AI/ML, and backend technologies with interactive hover effects and badges.
Interactive gallery with category filters, hover effects, lightbox modals, and smooth animations for project previews.
Projects section showcases four featured projects including project details, tech stacks, GitHub and demo links, and status badges.
Contact section with validated functional contact form, social links, email info, and resume download.
Dark/light mode theme provider with persistent theme storage and smooth transitions.
Footer with social media links, quick navigation, and copyright information.
user_flow_summary: User lands on homepage with hero section capturing attention via animations and call-to-action buttons.
User navigates through sections (About, Skills, Gallery, Projects, Contact) using the sticky header with smooth scrolling and active section highlights.
User filters gallery images by categories and views detailed project images in a lightbox modal.
User explores featured projects and accesses GitHub repositories or live demos via project cards.
User fills out and submits the contact form with validation, or connects via provided social links and downloads the resume.
User toggles between dark and light modes via the header theme toggle with the preference saved persistently.
validation_criteria: All mandatory features including navigation, hero, about, skills, gallery, projects, and contact sections are fully functional and responsive.
Contact form validates all fields correctly and submits without errors.
Dark/light theme toggling works across all pages with state persistence.
Performance metrics meet targets: Lighthouse score 90+, FCP under 1.5s, TTI under 3.5s, and CLS below 0.1.
Accessibility complies with WCAG AA standards with keyboard navigation, screen reader support, and ARIA labels.
Website renders correctly across supported browsers and mobile devices.
Animations and UI transitions are smooth and without jank.
